smoke.description: APU-only and representative Vulkan layer split, one short measured pass.

short.description: Structurally distinct Vulkan placements plus MTP n=2/3/4 at shallow context.

tuning.description: Vulkan wave-width and ubatch sweep for the representative 88/12 placement.

kv.description: Q8 versus F16 KV cache for the representative layer and MTP finalists.

context.description: Representative Vulkan finalists over increasing prompt depth.

strategy-smoke.description: One-pass Vulkan comparison of APU-only, component, forward/reverse layer, and row strategies.

placement.description: Three-round comparison of structurally distinct Vulkan placements.

vulkan-baseline.description: Vulkan decision screen with representative placements plus decode and long-prompt prefill metrics.

vulkan-kv-mtp.description: Focused iGPU-only target tests: F16 KV, dGPU MTP n=4, and F16 KV plus dGPU MTP n=4.

vulkan-f16-mtp-placement.description: Direct F16-KV comparison of no MTP, iGPU MTP, and 7900 XT MTP for the all-iGPU and 82/18 target placements.

vulkan-mtp-tuning.description: Focused MTP window and confidence-threshold tuning on the winning 82/18 F16-KV target placement with the draft model on the 7900 XT.

vulkan-ubatch-32k.description: Long-prompt ubatch 2048/4096 decision on the winning 82/18 F16-KV target, dGPU MTP n=4, p-min 0.75 placement.

vulkan-quant-h1.description: Matched current-versus-H1 quant comparison at the winning 82/18 F16-KV, dGPU-MTP n=4, p-min 0.75, ubatch-2048 placement.

vulkan-ple-ssd.description: Hot mmap/CPU PLE throughput and residency A/B after a 4K page/kernel warm-up with KV slot erasure.

vulkan-ple-ssd-cold-4k.description: Server-cold first-request PLE16 mmap/CPU residency measurement at 4K; physical read counters determine whether the file cache was actually cold.

vulkan-ple-ssd-cold-16k.description: Server-cold first-request PLE16 mmap/CPU residency measurement at 16K; physical read counters determine whether the file cache was actually cold.

vulkan-expert-shared.description: Focused F16-KV A/B of routed-expert-only versus routed-plus-shared-expert placement on the iGPU, with remaining target tensors on the 7900 XT.

vulkan-prefill.description: Prefill-only screen of structurally distinct ways to use the 7900 XT with a fixed iGPU baseline.

production-capacity.description: Allocation-only validation of the 90/10 fallback and 88/12 preferred Vulkan production layouts at two 256-Ki-token slots.

production-concurrency-smoke.description: Two genuinely simultaneous 32K prompts against either capacity-qualified production layout.

production-concurrency-full.description: Two-user production validation through near-full 256-Ki-token slots; run only after the capacity and smoke tiers pass.

production-concurrency-unified-smoke.description: Two synchronized 32K prompts with unified KV, testing whether shared batching eliminates separate-slot prompt/decode starvation.

production-concurrency-scheduler-memory-.description: Two synchronized 32K prompts comparing a 4096-token logical batch at fixed ubatch 2048, then Q8 KV to relieve PLE page-cache pressure.

production-concurrency-q8-timeslice.description: Q8-KV two-user 32K sweep of matched logical/physical batches, trading prefill graph length for interactive decode fairness.

rocm-smoke.description: Hot-cache gated ROCm 10 APU-only bring-up using the native joined PLE under mmap and comparing flash attention off/on after a 512-token PLE warm-up.

rocm-depth.description: Gated APU-only ROCm context-depth localization after backend-op correctness and smoke pass.

backend-smoke-matched.description: Backend-compatible Vulkan/ROCm APU-only comparison using identical quantized weights and inference settings: PLE16 CPU mmap for Vulkan, joined mmap/native PLE placement for ROCm, F16 KV, batch 2048, ubatch 512, and flash attention off/on.

rocm-placement.description: Focused hot-cache ROCm 10 placement test at 4K and 32K: APU-only, 82/18 layers, routed experts on iGPU, and routed plus shared experts on iGPU.

rocm-mtp.description: Focused hot-cache ROCm MTP placement test on the winning routed-expert target topology: no MTP, Q8 MTP n=4 on iGPU, and Q8 MTP n=4 on 7900 XT.

rocm-mtp-window.description: Short-prompt ROCm draft-window sweep on the winning 7900 XT MTP placement: n=2, n=3, and n=4 without repeating expensive 32K prefill.

rocm-mtp-prefill.description: ROCm MTP prefill sweep on the winning n=3 7900 XT placement: ubatch 512/1024/2048 and an orthogonal Q8 draft-KV test at the baseline ubatch.

rocm-mtp-finalists.description: Historical matched ROCm finalist run. Q8 draft KV and MTP batch/ubatch 4096 were rejected; production tiers use n=3, F16 draft KV, and batch/ubatch 2048.

rocm-ple-ssd.description: Hot joined-PLE ROCm A/B: automatic placement versus explicit CPU mmap/SSD backing, both on the production n=3 F16-draft-KV topology.

rocm-ple-storage-screen.description: Storage-only 64K production A/B: identical CPU PLE placement with mmap/SSD page-cache backing versus no-mmap non-file-backed unified-RAM residency.

rocm-hip-graphs-ab-32k.description: Matched production-topology A/B of HIP graphs enabled versus disabled, using one exact 32768-token prompt for warm-up and one for measured prefill/decode per arm.

rocm-ple-ram-capacity.description: Allocation-only 256K gate for the no-mmap, CPU-resident PLE production arm; run before attempting its near-full prompt.

rocm-ple-storage-full.description: Near-full 256K storage-only A/B between CPU-mmap PLE and the otherwise identical no-mmap unified-RAM arm; run only after the screen and RAM capacity gate pass.

rocm-256k-placement-screen.description: 64K performance and residency screen of incremental iGPU target placements with n=3 Q8_0 MTP on the 7900 XT, F16 target/draft KV, CPU-mmap PLE, and prompt cache disabled.

rocm-256k-tail-screen.description: 64K follow-up using dGPU-first contiguous tail-layer splits. Routed experts remain on the iGPU, PLE remains CPU-mapped, and n=3 Q8_0 MTP plus F16 draft KV remain fixed on the 7900 XT.

rocm-256k-capacity.description: Allocation-only one-slot native-256K screen; use its experiment selector after the 64K placement results identify candidates.

rocm-256k-full.description: One-slot native-256K proof with exact 128K and near-full 248K prompts; select only capacity-qualified placement finalists.

rocm-256k-fit-capacity.description: Allocation-only 256K fine screen after 88/12 proved quality-safe but narrowly OOM and 84/16 allocated with unacceptable quality/performance. Tests intermediate layer boundaries and smaller ubatches on 88/12.

rocm-256k-fit-quality.description: Initial 64K ubatch screen. Run 20260829-163847 exposed deterministic long-prompt task loss at ubatch 1536/1024, so its MTP acceptance values are diagnostic rather than candidate rankings.

rocm-ubatch-target-fingerprint.description: No-MTP isolation of ubatch-dependent long-prompt target state. Two fresh-server rounds capture four steps of top-20 token probabilities at identical 88/12 placement; decode throughput and answer quality are deliberately out of scope.

rocm-ubatch-target-correctness.description: Full-output no-MTP correctness isolation across ubatch 2048/1792/1536/1024/512. No n_probs instrumentation is used, and task anchors gate every 512-token response.

rocm-ubatch-mtp-repeatability.description: Two fresh-server repetitions of the n=3 F16-draft-KV MTP path at the same 88/12 placement and 32K prompt, with task-anchor gating so fluent prompt loss cannot rank as a valid result.

rocm-ubatch-quality-target-screen.description: Ground-truth 32K long-context quality screen without MTP across ubatch 2048/1792/1536/1024/512. Eight exact or JSON-validated cases run twice from fresh servers.

rocm-ubatch-quality-mtp-screen.description: Ground-truth 32K quality screen with fixed n=3 7900 XT MTP and F16 target/draft KV, run only after the target-only quality screen identifies safe ubatches.

rocm-256k-fit-full.description: Minimal final one-slot 256K production proof: one exact 253952-token request. Select ubatch 1536 first; use 1024 only as the higher-headroom fallback.

backend.description: Matched Vulkan and ROCm controls and heterogeneous placements.

vision-smoke.description: One deterministic image compares the BF16 CPU reference, BF16 on the 7900 XT, and Q8 on the 7900 XT.

vision.description: Two-round BF16 CPU/Vulkan and Q8 Vulkan correctness and performance comparison across shapes, OCR, and chart reasoning.

vision-mtp.description: Three-round BF16 projector comparison with and without MTP sharing the 7900 XT.

rocm-vision-smoke.description: BF16 ROCm vision bring-up: CPU projector reference, iGPU projector, then iGPU projector plus production n=3 MTP on the 7900 XT with F16 target and draft KV.

rocm-vision-mtp-resync-smoke.description: Compatibility regression for the Qwen4Exp MTP multimodal resync path. This proves the former crash is gone but does not replace the strict target-only/MTP quality A/B.

rocm-vision-mtp-strict-ab.description: Exact greedy A/B for the Qwen4Exp vision MTP strict-verification patch: matched iGPU BF16 projector target-only control versus n=3 MTP on the 7900 XT.

rocm-vision-mtp-auto-bypass-ab.description: Matched vision A/B proving that the server automatically disables drafting whenever a request contains media, without any caller-supplied speculative override.

rocm-vision.description: Full BF16 ROCm vision validation at the native 256K allocation: the production server keeps n=3 MTP loaded for text and automatically bypasses it when media is detected.

full.description: Expensive Vulkan-only validation template; prune to measured finalists before running.
